arms.diagnostic_note: The bundle designer incorrectly assumed iter-2 scored 69.5. Iter-2's h-ablation patch contains the grid-guided 2-opt + Or-opt + penalty-aware delta + prime scheduling solution that scores ~78.8. The iter-3 h-main approach (two-phase stale/exact pos[] 2-opt without Or-opt, penalty-aware delta, or prime scheduling) is a simpler algorithm that scores lower. The critical missing components are: (1) penalty-aware exact delta computation, (2) Or-opt city relocation, (3) prime scheduling post-pass. These components from the iter-2 solution contribute ~6.6 points.
